HIG-COMPONENTS-EDIT-MENUS-0002.title: Use familiar system interactions to reveal edit menus

statement.en: Let people reveal edit menus using the familiar system-defined interactions for each platform.
statement.ja: 各platformで慣れたsystem-defined interactionを使ってedit menuを表示できるようにする。

conditions: Support the applicable touch-and-hold, pinch-and-hold, and secondary-click conventions instead of introducing a custom interaction for a standard task.
HIG-COMPONENTS-EDIT-MENUS-0002.review_note: Retained SHOULD and recorded the platform interaction examples without converting them into universal gestures.

HIG-COMPONENTS-EDIT-MENUS-0004.title: Support undo and redo when possible

statement.en: Support undo and redo for edit-menu actions when possible.
statement.ja: 可能な場合はedit-menu actionのundoとredoをsupportする。

conditions: Because edit-menu actions don't require confirmation, provide recovery for changes where the app can restore prior state.
HIG-COMPONENTS-EDIT-MENUS-0004.review_note: Retained the when-possible SHOULD and recorded why recovery matters for immediately executed commands.

HIG-COMPONENTS-EDIT-MENUS-0005.title: Keep custom-command labels short

statement.en: Use short labels for custom edit-menu commands.
statement.ja: custom edit-menu commandには短いlabelを使う。

conditions: Keep the label concise while the separate action-wording rule preserves clarity.
HIG-COMPONENTS-EDIT-MENUS-0005.review_note: Retained SHOULD and separated label length from the source's independent wording requirement.

HIG-COMPONENTS-EDIT-MENUS-0007.title: Avoid controls that duplicate edit-menu commands

statement.en: Avoid adding other controls that duplicate familiar edit-menu commands.
statement.ja: 慣れたedit-menu commandを重複する別のcontrolの追加を避ける。

conditions: Preserve interface space for actions people may not already know how to access.
exceptions: A product requirement may justify a redundant control when the risk and space tradeoff are documented.
HIG-COMPONENTS-EDIT-MENUS-0007.review_note: Retained AVOID rather than raising the qualified in-general guidance to a prohibition.

HIG-COMPONENTS-EDIT-MENUS-0011.title: Avoid making control labels copyable

statement.en: Avoid making control labels selectable and copyable as content.
statement.ja: control labelをcontentとして選択・copy可能にすることを避ける。

conditions: Distinguish control labels from content text that people may reasonably reuse.
HIG-COMPONENTS-EDIT-MENUS-0011.review_note: Recovered the qualified not-control-labels clause as AVOID rather than an unconditional prohibition.

HIG-COMPONENTS-EDIT-MENUS-0012.title: Differentiate deletion-command behavior

statement.en: Differentiate edit-menu commands that delete content in meaningfully different ways.
statement.ja: contentを異なる方法で削除するedit-menu commandを区別する。

conditions: For example, Delete removes content directly, whereas Cut first copies it to the system pasteboard.
HIG-COMPONENTS-EDIT-MENUS-0012.review_note: Recovered the when-necessary deletion-semantics rule and preserved the Delete versus Cut distinction.

HIG-COMPONENTS-EDIT-MENUS-0015.title: Reposition edit menus only when necessary

statement.en: Reposition an iOS or iPadOS edit menu when necessary to keep important content visible.
statement.ja: 重要なcontentを見える状態に保つ必要がある場合はiOSまたはiPadOSのedit menuを再配置する。

conditions: Keep the default placement above or below the insertion point or selection when it works.
Move the menu when it would otherwise cover important content or interface areas.
exceptions: You can change the menu position, but not the shape of the menu or its pointer.
HIG-COMPONENTS-EDIT-MENUS-0015.review_note: Recovered the conditional placement rule and recorded both the default behavior and customization limit.
